name: Monterey County, CA
findings: Monterey County has 1,047 nonprofit organizations. 426 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 337 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Monterey County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 19 research and think tank organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Monterey County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

observations.text: 81 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
